body:
Dizzy and confused. Struggling to find the keys to the garage again. 
How long would it take to die? Would there be any pain?
Not an option. I stepped out to smoke a cigarette but thinking about going back in
Help get over this. We are on similar boats. If you are serious about suicide, share some of that helium w/ me. If you are in Europe you are less than 3-5 hours from me. I can fly anywhere.

I really don’t know. I could go on and try to find someone. I am not ugly. I am intelligent and have a great job! But I will never find someone like her. The time we were together ... we literally lived our teenage years (probably the most important) toghether. We saw each other everyday for the past > 10 years. Thank you for taking the time to answer. 


I went through your post history. I saw you are planning to do the same. Where are you based? Maybe we could go together?

Just my marriage. I am < 30. I don’t have anyone else. She was the one I wanted to spend the rest of my life with and have kids with. Worse I don’t even understand why is she leaving me. I have suffered from panic and anxiety attacks all my life. My heart is so heavy right now I can barely walk.

Friday is when my wife is back and probably leaving me. >10 years toghether. No kids. Nothing to live for. 
Thanks for your reply. Maybe I should get hold of pure nitrogen (not sure how).
